concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-005 (sensitivity analysis by sweeping entropy cut‑off points ±5% and reporting FID variance) has no corresponding task in tasks.md; the plan’s Phase 11 evaluation mentions it but no explicit task is defined to implement or verify this analysis.

Task T013 is tagged with `[US?]`, but no user story with that identifier exists in the specification (only US1, US2, US3 are defined). This stale tag should be removed or replaced with a valid US identifier.
